title: GitHub Actions Basics
subtitle: Read, write, and troubleshoot a small CI workflow.
description: Learn how events create workflow runs, how jobs and steps execute, how data crosses job boundaries, and how to keep a first workflow safe and observable.

lessons.title: From event to run
lessons.summary: Build the core mental model: an event selects a workflow, jobs go to runners, and steps execute in order.

lessons.title: Write a first CI workflow
lessons.summary: Read a complete workflow file and connect each YAML key to what GitHub will do.

lessons.title: Choose triggers and filters
lessons.summary: Start workflows from repository activity or a manual request, then narrow when they should run.

lessons.title: Connect jobs and data
lessons.summary: Control parallel work with dependencies and choose outputs, artifacts, or caches for different kinds of data.

lessons.title: Make workflows safe and debuggable
lessons.summary: Limit token permissions, treat external values as untrusted, and diagnose failures from trigger to side effect.
